title: CISA Catalog of Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (bundled subset)
_note: REAL subset of the CISA KEV catalog, verified against https://www.cisa.gov/sites/default/files/feeds/known_exploited_vulnerabilities.json (catalogVersion 2026.07.16). Of the CVEs in osv-bundle.json, only CVE-2021-3156 (sudo Baron Samedit) is genuinely KEV-listed; the openssl/zlib/curl CVEs are NOT in KEV and are deliberately omitted here so the loader marks kev=false for them. A real deployment syncs the full catalog (VD-4).

vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Sudo contains an off-by-one/heap-based buffer overflow (Baron Samedit) that allows a local user to escalate privileges to root.
